articles.title: How to prepare GSTR-1 from your saved bills
articles.summary: Prepare GSTR-1 tables (B2B, B2CS, notes, HSN summary) from bills saved in Nivesh Sahayak, fix the warnings, and download the JSON for the GST portal.

articles.title: GSTR-1 upload: JSON or the offline tool
articles.card: JSON upload or the offline tool
articles.summary: Two ways to put your Nivesh Sahayak GSTR-1 on the portal: upload the JSON directly, or use the Excel workbook or CSV files in the GST Returns Offline Tool.
